name: aka_agent_internal_route_data_group_member_v190_internal
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aka_agent_internal_route_data_group_member_v190_internal(p_source_id bigint, p_membership_id bigint, p_batch_id bigint, p_group_revision bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
      BEGIN
        -- v186 already enforces Zalo person, campaign-account ownership and a
        -- non-empty UID. v245 intentionally removes only relationship proof.
        RETURN public.aka_agent_internal_route_data_group_member_v186_internal(
          p_source_id, p_membership_id, p_batch_id, p_group_revision
        );
      END;
      $function$
